question: Can the exact current Muon direction select a fresh 64-stage c_proj topology every update quickly enough to eliminate measured sub-15-update staleness, while retaining the task effectiveness of the legacy greedy matcher?

causal_motivation.finding: periodically stored connectivity is already severely stale at the shortest observed age even when future angles are refit exactly
causal_motivation.structural_response: make connectivity stateless and current-direction-selected on every optimizer update instead of storing it across updates

candidate.name: single_pass_task_edge_coloring
candidate.description: Sort the current top-64 antisymmetric weight-direction edges once, then use a compiled single-pass edge-coloring algorithm to distribute those edges across 64 edge-disjoint perfect matchings.

metrics: post-GELU residual-output fixed-scale and positive-line recovery
end-to-end matching latency including score construction, top-k, sorting, host transfer, and native edge coloring

measurement_repair.repair: stop the orientation loop immediately after a successful repair and add an empty-candidate 64-channel/32-stage forced-completion stress test
